title: This Shrimp Is Louder Than a Gunshot 🔫 #shorts
description: The pistol shrimp's snapping claw creates a collapsing bubble that is briefly almost as hot as the Sun's surface.

scenes.text: This tiny shrimp can make a sound louder than a gunshot.
The pistol shrimp snaps its giant claw shut so fast that it shoots out a jet of water and a bubble.
When that bubble collapses, for a tiny instant, it gets almost as hot as the surface of the sun. It even gives off a flash of light.
The shock wave stuns or kills small fish and crabs.
Whole colonies snapping together are so loud, they can interfere with submarine sonar.
Follow for one odd lifeform every day.
